questions.text: Which SAP T-Code is used for daily activity confirmations throughout the parent-to-processing cycle?
questions.explanation: CO11N (Production Order Confirmation) is used at every stage — Rearing, Pre-Laying, Laying, Hatchery, and Broiler — to record daily activities, quantities, and events.

questions.text: What does TECO stand for in the context of closing a production order?
options: Technical Completion — order locked, no further postings
questions.explanation: TECO means Technical Completion. Setting TECO on a production order locks it — no further postings (GR, GI, confirmations) are allowed after this point.

questions.text: At what age milestone do Parent Rearing birds transfer to the Pre-Laying phase?
questions.explanation: Birds are raised in Parent Rearing to 19 weeks. A Goods Receipt (GR Pullets 19WK) is posted at this milestone, and the birds transfer to Parent Pre-Laying.

questions.text: What does DLV mean when closing a production order?
options: Delivery Completed — no more goods receipts expected
questions.explanation: DLV means the Delivery Completed indicator is set on the order, indicating that no further goods receipts are expected. It is set together with TECO at stage close.

questions.text: In Stage 4 (Parent Laying), which goods movement is posted daily?
questions.explanation: The Parent Laying stage posts a Daily Hatching Eggs GR — a Goods Receipt is recorded in SAP every single day as eggs are produced.

questions.text: What happens to depleted Parent Laying hens (Pullets 64WK)?
options: They are returned to rearing farms
They are always sold externally via Sales Order
A Goods Issue of by-product is posted; a decision is made to sell or send to processing
They are posted as waste and discarded
questions.explanation: At 64 weeks, a GI By Product (Pullets 64WK) is posted. The process then includes a decision point — if there is a plan to sell, they go to an external Sales Order; otherwise they are sent to Processing.

questions.text: What Goods Receipt is posted when Day-Old Chicks hatch from the Hatchery?
questions.explanation: When Day-Old Chicks (DOC) are produced by the Hatchery, a GR DOC (Goods Receipt of hatched Day-Old Chicks) is posted in SAP.

questions.text: In Stage 9 (Processing), what is posted after broilers arrive at the plant?
options: GR From Order → GR Carcass → Finished Product Packaging → Transfer to Store
questions.explanation: Processing follows the sequence: GR From Order (receiving live broilers), GR Carcass, Finished Product Packaging, and Transfer to Store — in that order.

questions.text: The detailed Diagram B adds which additional SAP feature to each production stage?
options: Activity Confirmations (CO11N) and Daily QM Data recording via SAP Fiori
questions.explanation: Diagram B (detailed SAP swim-lane) adds Activity Confirmations (CO11N) and Daily QM Data recording using SAP Fiori at each production stage, plus DLV & TECO order closing steps.

questions.text: What is the purpose of a Stock Transfer Order (STO) in Stage 7 — By-Product Store?
options: To post daily hatching eggs from laying farms
To move rejected egg by-products to the destination warehouse
To transfer live birds to the processing plant
To create a sales invoice for spent hens
questions.explanation: The By-Product Store stage creates an STO (Stock Transfer Order) to move rejected egg by-products, followed by an STO GR (Goods Receipt) at the destination warehouse.
